content: DMN XML serialization: root element <definitions> with namespace (version-specific: 1.5=https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/20230324/MODEL/), expressionLanguage, typeLanguage attrs. Contains itemDefinition, drgElement (decision, inputData, businessKnowledgeModel, decisionService), artifact. Decision table = <decisionTable> inside <decision> with attrs: hitPolicy (UNIQUE/FIRST/PRIORITY/ANY/COLLECT/RULE ORDER/OUTPUT ORDER), aggregation (SUM/COUNT/MIN/MAX for COLLECT), preferredOrientation (Rule-as-Row/Column/CrossTable). <input><inputExpression><text>FEEL expr</text></inputExpression></input>, <output typeRef="string">, <rule><inputEntry><text>...</text></inputEntry><outputEntry><text>...</text></outputEntry></rule>. Cross-file refs via href URI fragments on DMNElementReference. DMNDI element for visual layout (DMNDiagram/DMNShape/DMNEdge/DMNLabel/DMNStyle). XSD schemas normative from OMG (DMN15.xsd etc). extensionElements/anyAttribute for vendor extensions.
